$comment: Photos for the story page. Files live in assets/photos/. Alt text is required: it is what a blind reader gets and what everyone gets when an image fails to load. width and height let the browser reserve space so the page does not jump while images load.

photos.alt: Close-up of Koda, a black and white Siberian Husky, mouth open in a grin. One eye is ice blue, the other amber. A red longboard leans against a fence behind him.
photos.caption: One blue eye, one amber. The site's colours come from here.

photos.alt: Koda lying in the sand at the water's edge, looking back over his shoulder, with the sun setting over the ocean behind him.
Koda in the back of a car after TPLO surgery, wearing an inflatable grey recovery collar, with a green cast on his hind leg and a purple bandage on his front paw. He is panting and looks cheerful.
Koda asleep on an orthopaedic bed on his side, still in the inflatable collar, the green cast stretched out behind him.
Koda peering out from underneath a draped blanket indoors, only his face visible.
